## 简体中文

### 修复

- macOS 上的 `install.command` 和 `install.sh` 现在会在安装前清除打包的 Sempre 可执行文件及内置运行文件继承的隔离属性。首次授权安装器入口后，Sempre 以及 sing-box 等内置核心不再需要分别在“安全性与隐私”中放行或手动执行 `xattr`。

### 验证

- GitHub Actions 构建并为 Intel 与 Apple Silicon macOS bundle 生成来源证明。
- 两个已发布 ZIP 都包含修正后的安装器，并与公布的 `SHA256SUMS` 匹配。

### 已知限制

- 本版本未经过 Apple 签名或公证，因此 macOS 仍可能要求首次批准安装器入口。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.7...v2.0.8-beta.1)

## English

### Fixed

- On macOS, `install.command` and `install.sh` now clear inherited quarantine attributes from the packaged Sempre executable and bundled runtime files before installation. After authorizing the installer entry point once, Sempre and bundled cores such as sing-box no longer require separate Security & Privacy overrides or manual `xattr` commands.

### Verification

- GitHub Actions built and attested both Intel and Apple Silicon macOS bundles.
- Both released ZIPs contain the corrected installer and match the published `SHA256SUMS`.

### Known limitation

- The release is not Apple-signed or notarized, so macOS may still require the initial installer entry point to be approved once.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v2.0.7...v2.0.8-beta.1
